chunks.text:

> Original line ranges: 122-132; 167-190

Rockman technical data
Introduction
This is technical data that has been analyzed from the Rockman game ROM
for the purpose of making Rockman tool-assisted speedruns as precise as possible.
The disassembly of the game
has been an invaluable help in discovering these.
All numbers on this page are hexadecimal unless otherwise mentioned.
Coordinate system
In Rockman and Rockman 2, every object of the game has the following properties:
Screen number (00―FF), it tells which screen the object resides in.

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 coordinate system — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
X position (00.00―FF.FF), it tells where in the screen the object is in.
Y position (00.00―FF.FF), it tells where in the screen the object is in.
X speed (−80.00―7F.FF).
Y speed (−80.00―7F.FF).
The position of the object has 8 bits of decimal part,
but only the integer part can be observed on the screen.
Y coordinates increase towards the bottom of the screen
X coordinates increase towards the right
Negative Y speed means falling, positive Y speed means ascending
X speed is always positive. It is subtracted or added depending on Rockman’s facing.

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 jump curve — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
> Origin: _工具脚本/taspipe/游戏包/来源库/取证/tasvideos_gameresources_rockman_data_2026-11-23.txt
> Original line ranges: 196-208
> Qualification: Source-scoped technical evidence; no PAL/US regional equivalence is asserted.
In Rockman 1 and 2, when Rockman jumps, his Y speed is set to 04.DF.
In Rockman 3, when Rockman jumps, his Y speed is set to 04.A5.
In Rockman 4, when Rockman jumps, his Y speed is set to 04.C0.
Every frame, 00.40 is subtracted from his Y speed (0.25 in decimal).
In Rockman 1 and 2, if the Y speed grows smaller than −0C.00 (−12 in decimal), it is set to −0C.00.
In Rockman 3 and 4, if the Y speed grows smaller than −07.00, it is set to −07.00.
In Rockman 1 and 2, if the Y speed is larger than 02.1F and the player is not holding the A button, the speed is immediately set to 01.00.

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 climbing and transforming — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
> Origin: _工具脚本/taspipe/游戏包/来源库/取证/tasvideos_gameresources_rockman_data_2026-11-23.txt
> Original line ranges: 253-261
> Qualification: Source-scoped technical evidence; no PAL/US regional equivalence is asserted.
In Rockman 1 and 2, Rockman climbs at speed of 00.C0.
In Rockman 3, Rockman climbs at speed of 01.4C.
Transforming
In Rockman 1, Rockman’s Y speed and position are accumulated even during transforming. (Which allows him to pass through enemies without hurting himself.)
In Rockman 2, Y speed is reset when pausing. During transforming, enemies move. (Which allows them to pass through Rockman without hurting him.)

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 horizontal motion while jumping — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
> Origin: _工具脚本/taspipe/游戏包/来源库/取证/tasvideos_gameresources_rockman_data_2026-11-23.txt
> Original line ranges: 271-279
> Qualification: Source-scoped technical evidence; no PAL/US regional equivalence is asserted.
In Rockman 1 and 2, during jumping/falling into some direction, Rockman’s X speed is 01.50.
In Rockman 3 and 4, during jumping/falling, Rockman’s X speed is the same as when walking.
If the player stops pressing the directional button, the speed falls immediately into 00.00.
In Rockman 1, if Rockman starts moving after not moving, his X speed first goes to 00.20, then back to 01.50.
In Rockman 2, if Rockman starts moving after not moving, his X speed goes immediately back to 01.50.

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 walking speed — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
> Origin: _工具脚本/taspipe/游戏包/来源库/取证/tasvideos_gameresources_rockman_data_2026-11-23.txt
> Original line ranges: 281-287
> Qualification: Source-scoped technical evidence; no PAL/US regional equivalence is asserted.
Walking
Walking speed
In Rockman 1 and 2, during walking, Rockman’s X speed is 01.60.
In Rockman 3 and 4, during walking, Rockman’s X speed is 01.4C.

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 acceleration and deceleration — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
> Origin: _工具脚本/taspipe/游戏包/来源库/取证/tasvideos_gameresources_rockman_data_2026-11-23.txt
> Original line ranges: 289-305
> Qualification: Source-scoped technical evidence; no PAL/US regional equivalence is asserted.
Sliding speed
In Rockman 3 and 4, during sliding, Rockman’s X speed is 02.80.
Acceleration
In Rockman 1, when Rockman accelerates from non-full speed (full halt or deacceleration), his X speed is 00.20 for 9 frames before gaining full speed.
In Rockman 2, when Rockman accelerates from non-full speed (full halt or deacceleration, item-throwing halt excluded), his X speed is 00.20 for 7 frames before gaining full speed.
In Rockman 3, when Rockman accelerates from non-full speed, he walks normally the first frame (as far as speed is concerned), then is completely in stall for 8 frames, after which he has the full speed again.

chunks.heading: Rockman 2 acceleration and deceleration — verbatim extract
chunks.text:
Deceleration
In Rockman 1, when Rockman decelerates from full speed (not from acceleration), his X speed is 00.80 for 13 (decimal) frames before halting completely.
In Rockman 2, when Rockman decelerates from full speed (not from acceleration), his X speed is 00.80 for 8 (decimal) frames before halting completely.

洛克人2 官方说明书：A键 B键 跳跃 射击 爬梯 START 暂停 无敌（美国NES手册第4至5页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
左和右用于移动，跳跃或下落时仍可移动；上和下用于上下爬梯。
> Pushing RIGHT and LEFT on the controller moves Mega Man right and left. This works even when he is jumping or falling.
A键用于跳跃，按住越久跳得越高；在梯顶按上起跳会跌下梯子。
> The A button is used for jumping. The longer you hold the button down, the higher Mega Man will jump.
B键用于射击，跳跃或下落时也能射击。
> The B button is used for shooting. ... Mega Man can shoot while he is jumping or falling.
START用于切换武器、使用能量晶体、查看生命并暂停游戏。
> The START button is used for changing weapons, using energy crystals, ... It is also a convenient way to pause the game.
Mega Man受击后约有一到两秒无敌。
> When Mega Man is damaged, he is invulnerable for a second or two.

洛克人2 官方说明书：NORMAL DIFFICULT START PASSWORD STAGE SELECT 八名 Robot Master Wily（美国NES手册第3页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
标题画面用SELECT选择NORMAL或DIFFICULT模式，再按START开始。
> Use SELECT to choose NORMAL or DIFFICULT mode. Press START to begin the game.
玩家必须选择START或输入PASSWORD；PASSWORD选项在说明书后文说明。
> You must now choose to START or enter a PASSWORD.
STAGE SELECT画面显示八名敌方机器人和中间为Dr. Wily预留的位置。
> This screen has pictures of all eight enemy robots plus a slot in the middle for Dr. Wily.
用控制pad移动选择框，按START确认；初学者可先选Metal Man，或先试Air Man/Flash Man。
> Use the control pad to move the flashing box to the opponent of your choice and press START.

洛克人2 官方说明书：Energy Meter life energy pellet ball crystal 武器能量 1UP（美国NES手册第6至7页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
左上角Energy Meter显示还能承受多少伤害，归零时失去一条Mega Man生命。
> When the meter reaches zero points, one Mega Man life will be lost.
energy pellet和energy ball补充少量生命能量；energy crystal是满能量，可在电量低时使用。
> There is also an energy crystal. This is a full load of energy that Mega Man can carry around with him.
按START选择Energy crystal，再按START将能量补满，然后重新选武器并按START。
> Push the START button again to fill your energy back up to maximum.
选择标准Mega Man以外的武器时会出现第二能量表，表示当前武器剩余能量。
> This tells how much charge remains in the current weapon.
1 UP增加一名玩家。
> 1 UP. Adds One Player.

洛克人2 官方说明书：Heat Man Air Man Flash Man 特殊交通工具 飞行平台 喷气雪橇 电梯（美国NES手册第8页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
击败Heat Man后取得悬浮平台，最多可同时发射三个。
> Acquired when Heat Man is defeated. This is a levitation platform. Up to three may be launched at a time.
击败Air Man后取得喷气雪橇，可飞越困难区域。
> Acquired when Air Man is defeated. This is a jet sled. Use it to fly over difficult areas.
击败Flash Man后取得电梯，只能贴着墙使用，且能到达比悬浮平台更高的位置。
> Acquired when Flash Man is defeated. This is an elevator and may only be used against a wall.

洛克人2 官方说明书：PASSWORD 气泡 续作 Stage Select（美国NES手册第9页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
每击败一个敌人后，可选择Stage Select或Password。
> After defeating each enemy, you will have a choice between either Stage Select or Password.
选择Password会显示当前密码；记下气泡位置，下次可从同一游戏进度继续。
> Simply keep track of where the bubbles are and next time you begin the game, you can continue from that point.
下次开始选择Password，用控制pad移动光标，在原来有气泡的方格按A输入。
> Move the cursor around with the control pad and hit the A button in each square that had a bubble in it before.

洛克人2 官方说明书：HOW TO BEAT AIRMAN Air Tikk Lightning Lord Air Flend 龙卷风（美国NES手册第10至13页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
选Air Man关卡后，在每节末尾按START暂停，再按START返回游戏。
> Push the START button to pause at the end of each section. (Remember: You must push START again to return to the game.)
Air Tikk出现时跳上其角，射击Lump，并等待角降下后重复，五次后召唤下一只。
> Jump onto it as soon as it starts to lower its horns, run across and jump to the platform on the other side.
射击Lightning Lord，跳上其战车；随后对付Air Flend并进入Air Man房间。
> Jump up and shoot him until he explodes. Then jump onto his Thunder Chariot.
Airman投出会偏转子弹并造成伤害的小龙卷风；接近后快速射击。
> Airman throws small tornados which deflect your shots and damage you.

洛克人2 官方说明书：八名 Robot Master Wood Clash Quick Heat Metal Air Flash Bubble（美国NES手册第14至15页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
说明书的Weapons页列出八名Robot Master：Wood Man、Clash Man、Quick Man、Heat Man、Metal Man、Air Man、Flash Man、Bubble Man。
> Wood Man Clash Man Quick Man Heat Man Metal Man Air Man Flash Man Bubble Man
Mega Man每击败一个敌人就取得对方的力量。
> As Mega Man defeats each enemy, he acquires their powers.

洛克人2 官方说明书：Atomic Fire Air Shooter Leaf Shield Bubble Lead Quick Boomerang Time Stopper Metal Blade Crash Bomber 武器（美国NES手册第15页）
来源：Capcom《MEGA MAN 2》美国 NES 官方说明书，任天堂官方数字复刻。
核验：已读扫描页；中文为说明，英文为短引文；未收全本。
Heat Man的Atomic Fire可射出三种火球，按住B越久火球越大。
> The longer you hold the fire button, the bigger the fireball.
Air Man的Air Shooter发射小龙卷风。
> Air Shooter throws small tornados.
Wood Man的Leaf Shield形成护盾，叶片按控制pad方向投掷。
> The leaves are then thrown in the direction the control pad is pushed.
Bubble Man的Bubble Lead形成沿地面滚动的泡泡。
> Bubble Lead is a bubble that rolls along the ground in front of you.
Quick Man的Quick Boomerang最多连发三枚回旋镖。
> Quick Boomerang can throw up to three boomerangs.
Flash Man的Time Stopper暂时冻结所有敌人，但会持续消耗能量且不能提前关闭。
> It cannot be turned off early.

Metal Man的Metal Blade最多向任意方向投掷三枚，被说明书称为最佳通用武器且持续时间长。
> This is probably the best general purpose weapon and the energy lasts a long time.
Crash Man的Crash Bomber可掷向墙壁，短暂延迟后爆炸，可用于穿过某些墙壁。
> Crash Bomber can be thrown at walls and will detonate after a short delay.
